verdict.rationale: Pigment's own docs claim you can "run scenarios at the touch of a button to assess different assumptions" in its HR/workforce use case, which fits a hiring-wave scenario. Nothing in the pack shows how scenarios are created or compared side by side; variance analysis and staging environments are adjacent features, not scenario comparison. Missing for 10: documented side-by-side scenario comparison, evidence of building downside or slipped-quarter cases, in-depth scenario docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
